description:
Set the note on one item of a folder. Returns the item. Same as PATCH
    /v1/folders/{folder_id}/items/{item_id}. Free. Errors: 404 item_not_found.

folder_id.description: one of your folders (from list_folders or create_folder)
folder_id.title: Folder Id

item_id.description: an item of that folder (from get_folder or save_to_folder)
item_id.title: Item Id

note.description: the note, up to 1000 characters; "" or null clears it
note.title: Note

name: edit_folder_item
